verdict.rationale: The evidence shows ImageMagick is driven by structured CLI flags (e.g. `-resize 800x600^`) and language bindings, not natural-language commands. The published llms.txt only helps external LLMs read its docs; it is not a natural-language interface in the product itself. A command-line image tool could plausibly ship such an interface, so the axis applies, but nothing in the pack shows one.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
